name: backup
description: JSON export/import of the whole IndexedDB, persistent storage, „Alle Daten löschen“ (extra, not in core)
postInstall: Needs the storage and layout templates (src/lib/db/mutations.ts, src/lib/ui/)
Render <BackupCard getDB={getDB} /> on the settings page
Sync apps pass beforeWipe (e.g. () => syncClient.disable({ deleteRemote: true })); apps whose schema changed pass migrate for older backups
